description_en: Deletes an access domain name from the configuration of a Global Traffic Manager (GTM) 3.0 instance
description_zh: 根据传入参数删除GTM 3.0实例配置的接入域名
kebab_example: aliyun alidns delete-cloud-gtm-instance-config --accept-language en-US --client-token 1ae05db4-10e7-11ef-b126-00163e240000 --instance-id gtm-cn-jmp3qnw0000 --config-id config-000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteCloudGtmInstanceConfig

parameters.description_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh-CN: Chinese.

- en-US: English. This is the default value.

parameters.description_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique token for each request. The token can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters.

parameters.description_en: The ID of the Global Traffic Manager (GTM) 3.0 instance.
parameters.description_zh: 删除指定GTM 3.0实例配置的接入域名，仅支持删除单个。

parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.description_en: The ID of the instance configuration. A GTM instance can have two configurations, an A record and an AAAA record, for the same access domain name. The ConfigId uniquely identifies one of the configurations. To obtain the ConfigId, call the [ListCloudGtmInstanceConfigs](~~2797349~~) operation.
parameters.description_zh:
域名实例配置ID，相同接入域名、相同的GTM实例可以同时配置A和AAAA记录，此情况下相同的GTM实例会出现2个域名实例配置，ConfigId可以唯一标识域名实例配置。
调用[ListCloudGtmInstanceConfigs](~~2797349~~) 接口可查询域名实例对应的 ConfigId 值。
